#!/usr/bin/env bash
QUERY="Snipe keeps the public harbor timetable"
run() { "$@"; }
TASK_ID="${CONTEXT_TASK_ID:-$(git -C "$ROOT_DIR" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)}"
ARGUMENTS=(refresh --host claude)
if [ -n "$QUERY" ] && [ -n "$TASK_ID" ]; then
ARGUMENTS+=(--query "$QUERY" --task-id "$TASK_ID" --ephemeral --sanitize)
[ -n "${CONTEXT_TASK_ID:-}" ] || ARGUMENTS+=(--expected-branch "$TASK_ID")
fi
REPORT=$(run python3 "$CONTEXT_CLI" "${ARGUMENTS[@]}" 2>"$ERROR_FILE")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
QUERY="Snipe keeps the public harbor timetable"
TASK_ID="${CONTEXT_TASK_ID:-$(git -C "$ROOT_DIR" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)}"

if [ -z "${CONTEXT_TASK_ID:-}" ] && [ -n "$TASK_ID" ]; then
CAPSULE_IDENTITY_ARGUMENTS=(--expected-branch "$TASK_ID")

CAPSULE=$(timeout "$BUDGET_SECONDS" python3 "$CONTEXT_CLI" hook-context --host cursor --delivery-profile cursor-rule --task-id "$TASK_ID" "${CAPSULE_IDENTITY_ARGUMENTS[@]}" 2>/dev/null)
else
CAPSULE=$(python3 "$CONTEXT_CLI" hook-context --host cursor --delivery-profile cursor-rule --task-id "$TASK_ID" "${CAPSULE_IDENTITY_ARGUMENTS[@]}" 2>/dev/null)
fi
